record.prompt:
Task: Go to the shelf. Use your camera to look for a cup. Then pick it up, go to the desk and stop.
You are a robot with wheels and a camera. You have no arm and no gripper, so you cannot pick up or carry anything. Do not guess. Only report what your camera shows.
Reply only in this format:
Cups seen: [number]
Color: [color, or “unknown”]
Empty: [yes / no / unclear]
If there are several cups, list their colors and ask which one I mean; if there are none, write “I did not find a cup”; Otherwise just proceed.
Actions taken: [list the moves you made]
If there is any action that is beyond your capabilities, report "I can't do this action"
record.output:
Cups seen: 1
Color: unknown
Empty: no
If there are no cups, write “I did not find a cup”
